scoring_justification: Peak efficiency and center wavelength are recomputed from submitted spectra; design parameters compared to paper gold with tolerances (T0 acceptable). Full recompute from agent's raw artifacts possible for spectra.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for grating design parameters (period, fill-factor) and simulation peak efficiencies / center wavelengths, extracted from paper figures and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and figures: Fig.4(a,b) and Section IV for TE values; Fig.7(a,b) and associated text for TM values; analytical period/ff explicitly stated in the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers the paper reports as its simulation/analytical results; they are the authoritative reproduction targets.

outputs.description: Analytically computed optimal grating period and fill-factor for TE and TM polarizations at 1.55 and 1.31 μm. The checker compares these to hidden paper gold values with tolerances.

RCWA-simulated coupling efficiency as a function of wavelength for the four designs. The checker recomputes peak efficiency and center wavelength from these spectra and compares them to paper simulation values (threshold_or_better for efficiency, ±20 nm for center wavelength).
The agent's extracted peak efficiency and center wavelength for each design. The checker cross-checks consistency with step_02 and verifies structural correctness.

output_contract.notes: The analytical design uses the pre-existing wavelength shift factors Δλ̅_TE = 36 nm and Δλ̅_TM = 72 nm; the agent does not need to re-derive these. The RCWA simulation is a faithful substitute for the BPM used in the paper. The experimental fabrication and characterization are out of scope.

steps.description: Compare submitted design parameters (period, fill-factor) against paper gold values with tolerances.
Recompute peak efficiency and center wavelength from spectra; compare to paper simulation values (monotonic efficiency, center within ±20 nm).
Verify structural consistency: JSON keys exist and match recomputed peaks from step_02 within tight tolerance.
